$comment: The reference run of 01 §E.1 (BD-97, BD-147). Each sim_time is copied from a line of session.jsonl of this same run: START_EVA at seq 12 EVA_STARTED (04:11:00Z, plan.scenario.eva_start_utc); TASK_ROVER (UR1 RELAY to the cell scripts/relay-target.ts returns for this run) and the first JUMP_NEXT_STOP at 04:11:01Z, the time of seq 13 ALERT_RAISED (the first COMM_SHADOW caution); START_EVENT at seq 27 EVENT_STARTED (05:16:55Z, series_start_utc, U-62); the second JUMP_NEXT_STOP at that same time; the third at 05:40:16Z, when the crew reach stop 2 (seq 44 CLOCK_JUMPED, arrival), and it ends at the alert (seq 45 ALERT_RAISED, RADIATION_ALERT); APPROVE_OPTION for the VEHICLE_RENDEZVOUS option at 05:50:32Z, the time of seq 46 OPTIONS_PROPOSED (option id = alert id a-45 + the kind). Regenerate with make replay COMMANDS=scenarios/storm-sol4190/reference_commands.json; an engine change that moves a seq changes the alert id.
